methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $10M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Olympian Motors is a seed-stage transportation company founded by Eren Canarslan and Jasmine Sungu that has raised $9.6M to date. The transportation sector peer universe comprises six private companies including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Navier, and EarthGrid, with no public comparables available. No narrow peer set of same-stage or adjacent-stage companies with sufficient data density exists to support a peer-median valuation method.

Stage-progression analysis, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $9.6M raised baseline, implies a valuation of $24M. This represents the only quantitatively applicable method given data constraints. Peer-median triangulation was not pursued due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds within the transportation sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $20M to $28M, with a median point of $24M. This range reflects the stage-progression method's point estimate and typical measurement error bands around a single-method conclusion. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer validation, limited visibility into capital efficiency and burn rates relative to sector benchmarks, and the nascent state of reliable comparable data in frontier transportation. Valuation confidence is moderate; additional method triangulation would require either broadening the peer set across adjacent sectors or obtaining proprietary financial performance data from comparable seed-stage transportation companies.
